svg.title: Inoperative-equipment study path
svg.desc: Establish the applicable MEL or eligible no-MEL path; check the sources of requirements; meet maintenance and placarding requirements; make the specified hazard determination.

g.text: INOPERATIVE EQUIPMENT · QUESTIONS TO WORK THROUGH
Establish the applicable MEL / no-MEL path.
Check every applicable source of requirements.
§ 91.213(d) has eligibility limits. Work with your CFI and mechanic.
